newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 91-day bill yield up at 7.58 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 91-day bill yield up at 7.58 pct.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the central bank, sold 91-day bills worth 580 million taka, with the corresponding yield rising to 7.58 percent from the previous 7.54 percent at an auction on Wednesday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price of the accepted bids was 98.14 per 100 taka against 98.15, previously.

The bank also sold 1.21 billion million taka worth of 30-day bills at 7.0 percent against the previous 6.65 percent. The weighted average price of the bids was 99.42 per 100 taka against 99.45 taka, previously.
